0.name: Stable Budget
0.strategy: Long-tenured, lower-spending customers who are unlikely to leave. Maintain satisfaction; gentle nudges toward higher-value plans can increase LTV.

1.name: At-Risk VIPs
1.strategy: High-value customers with the strongest churn risk. The highest priority for any retention team. Proactive intervention and personalised offers are warranted.

2.name: Stable High-Value
2.strategy: Loyal, high-spending customers with low churn risk. Focus on rewarding loyalty and offering premium add-ons rather than discounts.

3.name: At-Risk Budget
3.strategy: Lower-spending customers showing elevated churn signals. Targeted outreach with competitive pricing or contract incentives may retain this group.
